entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Blazor WASM app fails to start on ASP.NET Core 10.0.0-preview4 and -preview5 #62423
  • OAuth Callback Url automatically assumes scheme from request and does not respect any ForwardedHeaders overrides #62422
  • Let InputFile's AdditionalAttributes be of type `IReadOnlyDictionary<string object>?` #62421
  • OpenApi set JsonOptions for specific endpoint #62420
  • [Blazor] Consider marking webview assets as `CurrentProject` #62419
    Backlog
  • Strange behavior with AddJwtBearer authentication policy that was working in .NET8 #62416
  • API proposal for `IHostEnvironmentNavigationManager.Initialize` #62415
    10.0-preview7
  • Make sure exceptions from `OnNavigateTo` are logged #62413
    10.0-preview7
  • Api proposal for `NotFoundEventArgs.Path` #62412
    10.0-preview7
  • ProtectedSessionStorage #62411
  • WebSocketTransport in Javascript/typescript client did not include headers set using IHttpConnectionOptions #62410
  • API proposal for `Router.NotFoundPage` #62409
    10.0-preview7
  • Api proposal for `UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute` #62408
    10.0-preview7

Closed

  • Perf regression: httpsys-hostheader-mismatch #62403
  • API proposal for NotFound related APIs #62375
    10.0-preview7

PullRequests

Created

  • [Blazor] Pass environment to runtime config only when defined #62418
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-wasm
  • [Blazor] Javascript bundler friendly #62417
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-wasm
  • Wrap OnNavigateTo callback with GetErrorHandledTask for proper exception logging #62414
    needs-area-label, Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • [release/10.0-preview6] Update Microsoft.OpenApi to preview28 #62407
    Servicing-approved

Merged

  • [release/10.0-preview6] Flip switch for controlling navigation flow on SSR #62377
    Servicing-approved, area-blazor, 10.0-preview6
  • [release/10.0-preview6] Fix PropertyGetter to handle value types correctly in SupplyParameterFromPersistentComponentStateValueProvider #62395
    Servicing-approved, 10.0-preview6
  • Update Microsoft.OpenApi to preview28 #62363
    affected-few, needs-area-label, 10.0-preview7

Updated

  • Add passkeys to ASP.NET Core Identity #62112
    area-identity
  • [release/10.0-preview6] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #62397
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • Fix ResourceAsset constructor to support RespectRequiredConstructorParametersDefault #62366
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • [Infrastructure] Avoid polluting the repo with changes on builds #62399
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Respect JsonSerializerOptions in validation errors #62341
    area-infrastructure
  • [SignalR] [Java] Fix NPE when closing hub connection during negotiation #62319
    area-signalr, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, 10.0-preview7
